title.narrative: Integration of Aquaculture and Fishery into the Rural Water for Sudan Program in Gedaref State, Eastern Sudan.

description.narrative:
Increased food security in Gedaref State.
Increase in food variation in Gedaref State.
15 stakeholders trained in how to integrate aquaculture into the water management program in Gedaref State, Eastern Sudan.
Around 50% of the participants will be female.

The first report (0) is a very short report which focuses on specific conditions and/or recommendations in the grant. There is no need to report on progress in achieving outputs and outcomes, which is done in the first annual report. As annex to the report 0, the consortium agreements between the partners should be submitted. The final report must reflect on the entire project period.

actual.value:
The training and evaluation are finalised in May of this year. 23 participants completed the training successfully. 100% of the trainees declared that the training increased their knowledge of fisheries and/or aquaculture.
Since the second training week (in December 2019) remarkable developments in aquaculture/fisheries were achieved in Gedaref State by the partcipated organisations. The
most important facts are:
- 19 of the 21 participants who returned the question form were involved in training beneficiaries in how to start or improve fisheries or aquaculture activities.
- 536 beneficiaries in Gedaref were trained in aquaculture or fisheries activities.
- The most important training subjects were focussed on:
· Awareness.
· Fish value chain improvement.
· The formation of cooperartive associations.
· Proper fishing methods.
· Fish handling and fish processing.
· Collective marketing of fish.
- 24 fish associations were started. Within these associations farmers and fishermen cooperate to improve the fish value chain from catch/harvest to consumption.
- One of the localities exploit an integrated farm with a fish pond, vegetables and fruit trees.
- Viberglass fishing boats and ice boxes were bought and distributed among associations to improve fish quality and decrease post-harvest losses.
- Transport of fish from the localities to the market in Gedaref was organized by cooling vehicle.
These trainings, equipment and activities made it possible to:
- Improve the fish quality.
- To neglect the middlemen and get better prices for the fish (by farmers/fishermen).
- To get access to the market and offer the fish to the consumers at lower prices.
The awareness of the importance of sustainable fishery and value chain approach among fishermen increased remarkably. As a consequence the fishermen themselves control
eachother concerning fisheries sustainability (illegal fishing, mesh size of nets, fish size), according to the state ministry (MPER).
The fishermen have been able to advocate their problems due to awareness raising i.e. They learned how to deal with government, fund raaising authorities, etc..
The local government noticed that the fish quality on the market improved and that it was offered at lower prices. As a token of appreciation the local government offered the
fish associations a shop for free to sell their fish.
All participated organisations agree that the development of the aquaculture sector in Gedaref state will get a huge boost if demonstration farms could be realised.
**Involvement of the school**
We were searching for a suitable site to implement the construction of the Community Farm System and found 2 potential sites. One at a secundary school (with 300 students) and one site of a private investor. We visited both sides and practised site selection. We selected the school site for several reasons. Important reason was the social objectives of the school director. He wanted to realise a demonstration farm where the students were taught how to farm fish, vegetables, fruits and livestock and how to farm integratedly
and where small farmers could see and be trained how to construct and how to run a Community Farm System. Here we could create a pilot farm!
All 9 organisations committed themselves to help the school to realise the Community Farm System as a pilot for Gedaref state. Also AquaFarmingConsult is available for
advise.
